description:
Native SSH, SFTP and terminal client with encrypted sync

Termoso is an open-source, self-hostable SSH, SFTP and terminal client for desktop and mobile with an end-to-end encrypted vault, no telemetry and no paywalls.
Signed desktop builds of Termoso 0.11.1.
Every installer ships with a minisign .sig; the app verifies it against the
public key compiled into the binary before installing an update. latest.json
is the updater manifest — mirror it (and the assets) on your own server to keep
update checks fully self-hosted; see docs/RELEASING.md.
Linux: _amd64 / .x86_64 bundles are for x86_64, _arm64 / _aarch64 / .aarch64
for 64-bit ARM (Raspberry Pi 4+, Apple Silicon VMs, Ampere and friends).
Windows: _x64 installers are for x86_64, _arm64 for Windows on ARM
(Snapdragon X, Surface Pro X and friends).
macOS: _aarch64.dmg is for Apple Silicon, _x64.dmg for Intel. Unless this
repository has a Developer ID configured, the builds are ad-hoc signed and not
notarized: after dragging Termoso to Applications run
xattr -cr /Applications/Termoso.app once (or right-click → Open) — see
docs/RELEASING.md.
